# StrStartsWithCanBeUsed

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 8.0" />

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `StrStartsWithCanBeUsedInspection`

`strpos($h, $n) === 0` is the pre-PHP 8 way to ask "does `$h` begin with
`$n`". PHP 8 provides `str_starts_with()`, which says it directly and does not
scan the whole haystack.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{4,5,6} [Before]
<?php
function route(string $uri, string $prefix): array {
    return [
        strpos($uri, $prefix) === 0,
        0 === mb_strpos($uri, '/api'),
        \strpos(strtolower($uri), $prefix) !== 0,
        strpos($uri, $prefix, 1) === 0,
        strpos($uri, $prefix) == 0,
        strpos($uri, $prefix) === 00,
        strpos($uri, $prefix) === false,
    ];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function route(string $uri, string $prefix): array {
    return [
        str_starts_with($uri, $prefix),
        str_starts_with($uri, '/api'),
        !\str_starts_with(strtolower($uri), $prefix),
        strpos($uri, $prefix, 1) === 0,
        strpos($uri, $prefix) == 0,
        strpos($uri, $prefix) === 00,
        strpos($uri, $prefix) === false,
    ];
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 4: Replace with &#39;str_starts_with($uri, $prefix)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 5: Replace with &#39;str_starts_with($uri, &#39;/api&#39;)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 6: Replace with &#39;!\str_starts_with(strtolower($uri), $prefix)&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "StrStartsWithCanBeUsed": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore StrStartsWithCanBeUsed

/**
 * @noinspection StrStartsWithCanBeUsedInspection
 */
```
